name: Kevin O'Reilly
psychographics: Traditionalist; prefers face-to-face interactions; skeptical of new gadgets unless they solve a clear problem.
current_solutions: Uses an AIB Bank debit card for all transactions; reads the Irish Examinator daily; listens to RTÉ Radio 1 during his commute.
frustration: Spent 45 minutes at 11:00 AM trying to navigate the AIB online portal to transfer funds, only to be met with a 'session expired' error message.
decision_style: Asks friends and family for recommendations; rarely reads online reviews, trusts word-of-mouth more.
voice: Blunt and concise; uses Irish slang like 'sure look' and 'deadly' naturally; short sentences.
